<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def hs(fr):
    nodes=fr.segmentation['nodes'];d={}
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color'] in('b','S') and n['pixels']==8:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']];cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if 17<=min(rs)<=23: d[n['color']]=(min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs))
    return d
def timer(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n');w=0
    for r in range(64):
        if a[r][62]=='W': w+=1
    return w
seq=['RIGHT','UP','DOWN','RIGHT','UP','DOWN','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT']
for a in seq:
    action([a],intent='explore')
    res=last_action_result
    h=hs(current_frame);t=timer(current_frame)
    print(f"{a}: {h} timerW={t} done={res.get('done')} lvl={res.get('level_completed')} noimp={res.get('no_impact')}")
    if res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over'):
        print("WIN/END");break
    if t>55:
        print("TIMER LOW");break
</parameter>
</function>
